Cookie Notice

DRAFT — pending legal review. Last updated: 9 August 2026.

What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the website remember your preferences and understand how you use the site.

Cookies we use

Essential cookies

These cookies are necessary for the website to function. They cannot be disabled.

  • Session cookie: maintains your language preference during your visit
  • Security cookie: protects against cross-site request forgery

Analytics cookies (future)

When implemented, analytics cookies will help us understand how visitors use our website. These will only be set with your explicit consent. We will use privacy-respecting analytics that do not track individual users across websites.

Managing cookies

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect website functionality.

Third-party cookies

We do not currently use any third-party cookies. If this changes, we will update this notice and request your consent where required.

Contact

For questions about our use of cookies, contact us at info@kraalcode.com.
